drafts.draft_en:
Blade Runner, but it's 1955.

Same shots. Different decade.

Made with AI 🎞️
drafts.video_tip: Copy techhalla's 'Matrix but it's 1981' format: 15-20s of iconic shots re-imagined in one era (film grain, period lenses, color), 4-word caption, no tool talk. Pick a film you can render convincingly; tools/prompt in reply 1.

drafts.draft_en:
AI can now rebuild a film VFX shot from scratch.

Original on the left. Mine on the right.

Can you tell which is which? 👇
drafts.video_tip: Split-screen original vs your AI recreation, synced cuts, 10-12s; label sides only at the end. Use a short reference clip and credit the film to stay on the safe side.

drafts.draft_en:
I tested Kling 4.0 vs Seedance 2.5 Flash on the same VFX shot.

One nailed the destruction physics.

Results 👇
drafts.video_tip: Same prompt, side-by-side, same seed/duration, one collapse or explosion shot; only post if you actually ran both. New-release window is short.

--sref in the replies.

drafts.video_tip: 4-image grid + a 6s animated version of the best frame (image-to-video). Sref posts earned 140 bookmarks for MayorKingAI - save-bait.
